# Emre Şavklı (Nazım Emre Şavklı)

> Freelance Flutter and full-stack developer with 10+ years in software development, building and shipping cross-platform apps, web panels and the backends behind them. Based in Istanbul, Türkiye, working remotely with teams in Europe, the UK and the Middle East (GMT+3). Open to freelance and contract work. Also offers business systems, admin panels, SEO and GEO.

## Services

- Mobile app development: cross-platform iOS and Android apps with Flutter, released and maintained on the App Store and Google Play.
- Web application development: customer portals, booking and ordering systems built with Next.js and React.
- Business systems: internal process digitisation, approval flows, reporting, role-based access and integrations.
- Admin panels and content management: panels to manage content, users and orders without code.
- Backend, API and payments: Supabase, Go, PostgreSQL, Firebase; Stripe, iyzico and RevenueCat subscriptions.
- AI features: in-app analysis and assistants with the OpenAI API.
- SEO and GEO: technical SEO, structured data and content structure for visibility on Google and in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity.

## Selected projects

- Lara Laundry (shipped): on-demand laundry marketplace. Customer app, staff operations app and admin panel on one backend: booking, live order tracking, a wallet-and-loyalty ledger, coupons and payments. Role: full build. Flutter, Go, PostgreSQL.
- Farabi BES (shipped, in daily use): work-based training platform for a vocational high school (85 students, 22 teachers). Teacher and coordinator app plus web admin panel: attendance, placements, salary-receipt tracking, approval flows, PDF reports. Role: full build (co-developed). Flutter, Next.js, Supabase.
- Northwind (concept): retail operations platform with a product-led marketing website and a data-dense admin dashboard. Role: design and front-end. Next.js, React, TypeScript.
- Pulse (concept): AI-guided strength and fitness coaching with an adaptive weekly plan, live set tracker and muscle map. Role: product design and front-end. Flutter, Riverpod, HealthKit.
- Nesto (concept): on-demand home services with booking, live map tracking and in-app payment. Role: product design and front-end. Flutter, Maps SDK, Stripe.
- Sofra (concept): restaurant ordering and delivery with menu, customisation, cart and live delivery tracking. Role: product design and front-end. Flutter, Go, Maps.
- Also built: Yaser Turizm, a B2B tour-operations app (seat planning, group bookings, Excel/PDF export), and own subscription apps on the App Store and Google Play.
